business_summary: Kyland Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides industrial internet solutions in China and internationally. The company offers industrial internet OS/cloud platform; industrial communication chips/bus chips; industrial ethernet solutions, including layer 3 backbone, rackmount, DIN rail, EN50155, un-managed, TSN, HSR/PRP, and PoE ethernet switches, as well as multi-function switching platforms, optical fiber converters, industrial ethernet modules, network management software, SFP modules, and accessories; time servers; industrial, traffic, and power servers; serial device servers and intelligent gateways; smart city; and energy internet products. It also provides power solutions, such as power distribution automation, substation automation, wind power networking, and solar power networking; and rail solutions comprising high speed rail signaling system security data network, data transmission network for mass transit signaling system, IP based TCMS network for onboard systems, PIS/PA networking, AFC networking, ISCS network aggregation, and power SCADA networking solutions for railway traction system. In addition, the company offers oil and gas solutions, which include digital oil and gas field communication network, oil and gas pipeline monitoring and SCADA communication network, and oil refining automated communication network; and automation solutions, such as automobile manufacturing management system and electronic factory automation system. Its products are used in aviation, shipbuilding, rail and subways, smart grids, power production, petrochemical, metallurgy, factory automation, smart traffic, urban management, and network operators fields. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
